The Launch Constitution

The declaration must stand on the front alone.

  1. One print area: production starts front-only.
  2. Selective ceremony: seals, Latin, and heraldry appear only where the issue requires formal standing.
  3. Extended provenance: QR records, titles, and lineage begin online or in packaging—not as compulsory garment decoration.
